![Threat Monitor screensaver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kuydigital/threat_monitor/main/docs/screens.png)

**Scores now start from official ratings.** WAR, CYB and BIO used to measure only how much of the news was about each threat. Now each starts from the agency that tracks it, and the day's news moves that by up to 15 points either way:

- **WAR:** [INFORM Severity](https://drmkc.jrc.ec.europa.eu/inform-index/INFORM-Severity) (EU JRC, UN OCHA and ACAPS) counts the conflict crises it rates Very High each month. A typical month since 2020 (17) reads about 35; the most so far (21, the count right now) reads about 73.
- **CYB:** CISA. Each actively exploited vulnerability added this week counts, twice if ransomware uses it, and each joint cybersecurity advisory of the last two weeks counts more.
- **BIO:** CDC travel health notice levels (Level 4 counts most), plus 15 points while the World Health Organization names a public health emergency of international concern.

If one of these sources can't be reached, that score falls back to the news alone, as before. DIS (GDACS) is unchanged. Created and maintained by Oliver Kuy.

Install the same way as before: on Windows, unzip and double-click **install.bat**; on a Mac, double-click **Threat Monitor.saver**. On a Raspberry Pi, run the one-line installer again to update. If you're updating on a Mac, log out and back in afterwards so macOS loads the new version.
